name: centroid-ai
description: Generic Centroid CNC12 skills and PLC tools for Claude Code and Codex

plugins.name: centroid-plc
plugins.description: Write, read and debug Centroid CNC12 PLC programs (MPU11/ALLIN1DC and Acorn), and compile-check or format .src files with Centroid's own compiler.

plugins.name: centroid-vcp
plugins.description: Customize the Centroid CNC12 Virtual Control Panel: buttons, skins, graphics, LED states and PLC-wired actions.

plugins.name: centroid-cnc12-ops
plugins.description: Operate Centroid CNC12 Mill and Router software: menus, jogging, part zero, tool offsets, running jobs, and G/M-code, parameter and message lookup.
